name: 171. Retargeted Claude request fits the target model (PR #7732) (retarget-fit)
description: A routing rule, fallback or load-balancer can retarget a request built for one Claude model onto another after the client sized it. Claude Code sizes for Opus (max_tokens 128000, thinking adaptive, output_config.effort xhigh), and the Claude Code body is forwarded verbatim with only the model swapped, so Haiku 4.5 rejected it with "max_tokens: 128000 > 64000" and "adaptive thinking is not supported on this model", and Opus 4.5/4.6 rejected effort xhigh ("Supported levels: high, low, medium" / "high, low, max, medium"). Every builder path now fits the request to the target: max_tokens is clamped to the model's max_output_tokens (datasheet row, else the static Claude table), adaptive thinking on a pre-adaptive Claude becomes enabled with a budget in [1024, max_tokens), and output_config.effort snaps onto the model's ladder. The Claude Code cases send the Opus-sized body straight to the target model, which takes the same forwarded path a routing rule does after it swaps the model; they read the provider-bound body back from the log row (x-bf-store-raw-request-response) since the response is Anthropic's own bytes. The rebuilt-path cases read it from extra_fields.raw_request (x-bf-send-back-raw-request). Every case is red before PR #7732 (Anthropic 400) and green after.
